contentEn:
Metro Vancouver condo renovations cost more than comparable house projects — not because of labour rates, but because of the regulatory, logistical and insurance environment that only applies inside a strata building. Before signing a contract, owners need to understand strata approval timelines, permit requirements by municipality, and the cost gap between cosmetic refreshes and a full pre-sale renovation.

From 聚星裝修' 58 completed projects across the region, the most common condo renovation budgets fall into three bands. These are all-in figures including materials, labour and permit-related fees.

What does a condo renovation cost in Metro Vancouver?

Cosmetic refresh — painting, flooring, new fixtures — typically runs $15,000 to $25,000. A mid-range kitchen and bathroom update with new cabinets, countertop and tub-to-shower conversion lands between $25,000 and $55,000. A comprehensive renovation with layout changes, structural work or a full-unit gut ranges from $55,000 to $90,000 or more.

What drives condo costs above house renovation prices?

Five factors routinely push condo costs above comparable house work. Strata approval requires a formal proxy form and a strata council vote before any permit application can be filed — approval timelines run two to six weeks. Building insurance requirements mean contractors must carry commercial general liability plus WCB for every job site; strata corporations increasingly require proof before approving a contractor. Material logistics in high-rise buildings add $500 to $1,500 per job because cabinets and appliances must go through freight elevators at scheduled hours. BC Building Code requires all penetrations through fire-rated demising walls to be sealed with approved firestopping products; one Coquitlam bathroom renovation incurred $3,200 in firestopping material alone. Structural work involving load-bearing walls requires a signed engineer letter, which typically costs $1,500 to $3,500 in Metro Vancouver.

How does strata approval work?

Most interior renovations in a strata building require a Form B and a strata council vote. 聚星裝修 handles the full strata approval process on every contract, including preparing Form B and proxy documentation for council review, directly liaising with the strata management company, providing insurance certificates naming the strata corporation as additional insured, and coordinating engineer letters when structural work is involved.

One Richmond condo bathroom renovation — converting a bathtub to a curbless shower and upgrading tile — closed for $28,400 including strata approval, permits, materials and labour. The owner received three contractor estimates before choosing 聚星裝修; the other two came in at $34,000 and $41,000 respectively.

Condo renovation permit requirements by municipality

Vancouver requires a building permit for any structural change, electrical panel upgrade, or plumbing relocation. Burnaby and Richmond follow similar thresholds. New Westminster requires a separate plumbing permit in addition to the building permit for any work involving drain-waste-vent modifications. Coquitlam and Port Moody follow the BC Building Code with minor municipal amendments. Always confirm with the specific municipality before starting design work.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a condo renovation cost in Metro Vancouver in 2026?

A cosmetic condo renovation in Metro Vancouver costs $15,000 to $25,000. A mid-range kitchen and bathroom update typically runs $25,000 to $55,000. A full-unit gut renovation ranges $55,000 to $90,000 or more, depending on the building's age, strata requirements and material selections.

Do I need strata approval for a condo renovation in BC?

Yes, in most cases. Strata council approval is required for any renovation that affects common property, structural elements, or the exterior of a unit. Even internal work like moving plumbing or removing a wall typically requires a formal vote. The process takes two to six weeks before a building permit can be applied for.

Can I do a renovation in a strata building without permits?

No. Structural work, electrical upgrades, and plumbing modifications all require permits in BC. Working without permits risks fines, strata violations, and complications when you sell. Insurance claims for work done without required permits are typically denied.

How long does a condo renovation take in Metro Vancouver?

A cosmetic refresh takes four to six weeks. A mid-range kitchen and bathroom update typically takes eight to twelve weeks. A full-unit gut renovation can take four to six months from initial design through completion and strata sign-off.

溫哥華都會區的公寓裝修費用比同等規模的獨立屋裝修更高——原因不在人工，而在於共管公寓大樓特有的監管規定、物流限制和保險要求。在簽約之前，業主必須了解 strata 審批時間表、各市許可要求，以及從簡單翻新到全面預售裝修的成本差異。

根據聚星裝修在該地區完成的 58 個項目，最常見的公寓裝修預算可分為三個層級，含材料、人工和許可相關費用的全包價格。

溫哥華公寓裝修要多少錢？

基礎翻新——刷漆、更換地板、更新衛浴設備——通常在 $15,000 至 $25,000 之间。中檔廚房與衛浴升級（新櫥櫃、檯面、浴缸改淋浴）落在 $25,000 至 $55,000。全面翻新（格局變動、主體結構工程、全屋改造）則在 $55,000 至 $90,000 以上。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即獲取聚星裝修的免費、無義務報價。

什麼原因導致公寓裝修比獨立屋更貴？

五個因素持續墊高公寓裝修成本。Strata 審批需要正式委託表單和 strata 管委會投票，在遞交建築許可申請前需時 2 至 6 週。建築保險要求承包商在每個工地均持有商業責任險及 WCB 工人補償保險。材料物流在高層大樓中使每個工地成本增加 $500 至 $1,500。BC 省建築規範要求所有穿透耐火分間牆的孔洞必須使用認可的防火材料密封。結構工程涉及承重牆時需工程師簽署函件，在溫哥華通常為 $1,500 至 $3,500。

範圍低中高
廚房（櫥櫃、檯面、電器）$20,000$32,000$55,000

Strata 審批如何運作？

大多數公寓內部裝修需要 Form B 及 strata 管委會投票。聚星裝修在每份合約中均包含完整 strata 審批流程代辦服務，包括準備 Form B 及代表文件供管委會審查、直接與 strata 管理公司聯繫、提供命名 strata 管委會為附加被保險人的保險證書，以及協調需要結構工程時的工程師函件。

列治文一間公寓的衛浴翻新工程——將浴缸替換為無障礙淋浴間並升級瓷磚——含 strata 審批、許可證、材料和人工在內總費用為 $28,400。業主在選擇聚星裝修前收到了三份承包商估算；另外兩份分別為 $34,000 和 $41,000。

各市公寓裝修許可證要求

溫哥華對任何結構改建、配電箱升級或管道移位均要求建築許可證。 Burnaby 和列治文遵循類似標準。New Westminster 要求在進行任何排水廢排系統改建時，除建築許可證外還需单独管道許可證。高貴林和穆迪港遵循 BC 省建築規範，附帶少量市級修訂。施工前務必向所在市確認具體要求。

常見問題

2026 年溫哥華公寓裝修多少錢？

溫哥華都會區基礎公寓裝修費用在 $15,000 至 $25,000 之间。中檔廚房與衛浴升級通常在 $25,000 至 $55,000。全屋改造在 $55,000 至 $90,000 以上，具體取決於大樓年份、strata 要求和材料選擇。

BC 省公寓裝修需要 strata 審批嗎？

在大多數情況下需要。影響公共財產、主體結構或單元外觀的任何裝修均需要 strata 管委會批准。即使是移動管道或拆除牆壁等內部工程，通常也需要正式投票。該流程在遞交建築許可申請前需時 2 至 6 週。

公寓裝修可以不申請許可證嗎？

不可以。結構工程、配電升級和管道改建在 BC 省均需要許可證。無許可證施工面臨罰款、strata 違規及出售房產時的糾紛風險。

溫哥華公寓裝修需要多長時間？

基礎翻新需 4 至 6 週。中檔廚房與衛浴升級通常需 8 至 12 週。全屋改造從初步設計到完工及 strata 驗收可能需要 4 至 6 個月。

聚星裝修代辦 strata 審批嗎？

是的。每份聚星裝修合約均包含完整 strata 審批管理——Form B 準備、管委會聯繫、保險證書及工程師協調。該服務包含在項目合約中，不另收費。
